body:
Tuesday at dusk: two workers from the pest-control test carried black specks. the garden browned before the checkpoint appeared.

I thought the date would settle it. When I asked, the person at the barrier looked at the seal instead and handed it back.

The person who was supposed to collect it had no time to stop. I did not put it back with the rest of the ordinary papers.
title: Tuesday at dusk — black specks
gloss: A personal trace connects a farm trial to symptoms before a later restriction.
rival_reading: Emergency workers could have picked up the same black specks while responding near a field; this personal trace does not prove the trial caused the emergency.
